# SignalFlow Studio

> SignalFlow Studio is an open-source, approval-first content operating system for turning meaningful work, manual thoughts, and connected-source evidence into reviewable communication while keeping final judgment with the user.

## Current product truth

SignalFlow has an accepted browser-local owner Golden Path 1 and an active, not-yet-accepted Golden Path 2 around real GitHub work → ContentSignal → ProjectContext/Opportunity → planning → exact LinkedIn/X review → automatic evidence where justified.

The older manual campaign builder remains available as a compatibility/Create foundation, but it is not the permanent product architecture.

## Implemented foundations

- Manual ContentSignal intake and lifecycle.
- Browser-local owner opportunity/angle, identity/Voice, NarrativeStrategy, ContentPiece, LinkedIn/X revision, evidence/authenticity review, exact approve/reject, StyleMemory and NarrativeMemory foundations in the accepted owner path.
- Owner-scoped hosted GitHub SourceConnection/event ingestion and Postgres-backed ContentSignal, ProjectContext, ContentOpportunity, planning/revision, review, opportunity-job, and private Asset persistence paths where configured.
- Versioned capability discovery at `/api/capabilities`.
- Real model-provider adapters subject to deployment/session policy.
- Deterministic Markdown/JSON export.
- Canonical Asset, SourceArtifact, and AssetProcessing records across supported source and persistence boundaries.
- Explicit `.signalflow.json` archive preparation, validation, browser import/recovery, conflict handling, resume, and rollback for supported Campaign state.
- MCP tools for capability/provider checks, validation, hosted strategy, destination generate/retry/edit, review retrieval, trackable campaign work, cancellation, and deterministic export.
- Official connector code paths for LinkedIn, X, and Reddit where genuinely configured and verified.

## Important boundaries

- General Campaign cloud autosave/workspaces/collaboration are not implied by the hosted Content OS record stores.
- Database-backed durable job state does not by itself mean an always-on background worker exists.
- GP2 is not complete until the real connected-source positive and noise-control acceptance evidence closes #167.
- Automatic screenshot/media production has bounded implementation foundations but still requires live acceptance for the active GP2 journey.
- Broad carousel/video/image-generation production, collaboration, multi-tenant SaaS breadth, and durable GP3 publication remain later/incomplete capabilities.
- Direct publishing success is claimed only after the destination API confirms it.
- Planned architecture in `docs/` is not a shipped-capability claim.
